goal: 在 B 维度新建第一条前近代 Theme B.5「陶器工艺与陶系传统」与 B.5.1–B.5.2 两个 Topic，挂载史前制陶技术、陶系类型与考古学文化共 27 个 KU；陶与瓷按材料分工，瓷器留待 B.6。

planned_topics_not_created: B.5.3 商周至秦汉的陶器、明器与建筑用陶
B.5.4 低温釉陶：铅釉、唐三彩与辽宋三彩

unresolved: Pottery origins: all six volumes offer only the 'clay adhering to a fired basket' conjecture; no experimental archaeology, no dated sequence, no complete description of the earliest pots
Xianrendong pottery is uniformly dated to '8000+ years ago' across the six volumes, with no dating method or laboratory code; later re-dating lies outside this corpus and was not used

Whether 'painted-pottery culture' equals 'Yangshao culture' is self-contradictory across the volumes: one equates them, another separates them and adds a note in the 2016 edition that the equation is inverted; not adjudicated

The five painted-pottery types (Banpo, Miaodigou, Majiayao, Banshan, Machang) have no stated criterion (vessel form, motif, distribution or date); their succession rests on single sentences and one volume only
All five type dates (c. 7000-6000, 6000-5000, 5000, 4500, 4000 BP) come from Tian Zibing alone, with no dating method or specimens
Liangzhu culture has three incompatible placements: one of four Longshan types, an independent archaeological culture, or one of six native design regions
Pottery vs. porcelain boundary (proto-porcelain, geometric stamped hard pottery, glazed earthenware) is inconsistent across the volumes; the B.5/B.6 division must be re-examined when B.6 is created

Painted pottery (painted before firing) and painted earthenware (painted after firing) have opposite process definitions across four volumes (Tian Zibing and Gao Feng vs. both Xia Yanjing editions); the batch records both without adjudication
Qujialing and Xindian cultures are single-source, low-confidence, one-line entries; distribution, dating and pottery periodization are all missing
No volume gives kiln temperatures, clay recipes, labour hours or firing yields; the 'forming-firing-material as a set' framework is this library's interpretation, not the sources'
B.5.3-B.5.5 were not created; creating empty Topic nodes was rejected as filling structure without material. Their candidate pools are recorded in this manifest and in dimension-candidates.md

Roughly 1500 B-dimension KUs remain unmounted outside pottery: bronze and metalwork, lacquer, furniture and woodwork, textiles and premodern dress, architecture and bridges, jade and glass. Whether to continue with material-based B.6/B.7... or switch to problem-based cross-material themes must be decided before B.6
notes: 本批新建 1 个 Theme（B.5 陶器工艺与陶系传统）与 2 个 Topic（B.5.1–B.5.2），挂载 27 个 KU。结构设计的两项判断：其一，陶与瓷按材料分工，B.5 只收陶器、低温釉陶、建筑用陶与紫砂，瓷器与原始瓷留待 B.6，避免把八千年制陶史与制瓷史压进同一 Theme；其二，B.5 内部按“成形—烧成—原料”三项技术变量与“日用—明器—建筑—茶器”四种用途两轴组织，不按朝代罗列。B.5.1 收 10 个技术、分期、起源与遗址条目；B.5.2 收 3 个陶系、5 个彩陶类型、1 个器形总类与 8 个考古学文化，共 17 个。B.5.3–B.5.5 未建立：本批拒绝为尚无挂载材料的材料组预先物化空 Topic，其候选池记入本 manifest 与 dimension-candidates.md。史前部分的分歧一律并列保留不裁：彩陶文化与仰韶文化是否等同、五型彩陶的划分依据、良渚文化的三种归属、彩陶与彩绘陶相反的工序定义、屈家岭与辛店的低置信单源。本批同时把 v1.11 记录的“前近代无 Theme 可挂”改为“已部分缓解而非闭合”，并指出约 1500 个 B 维度未挂载 KU 仍无 Theme，B.6 动工前需在“按材料组”与“按生产技术问题”两条路线间作出决定。v1.11 归档哈希 ee74e57e471c326a6a004be42e8610a6e56c81b542819dce5668ed657695d80d 与 h20 apply-plan 记录逐字节一致。未新增 KU、claim、candidate 或来源字节，未改写 03基础书籍-md文档/ 与 02-sources/，未执行 commit 或 push。
